# SW2URDF 2026-09-11 Beta 1

> DRAFT / 未公开发布：安装包已构建并实测。公开下载仍待新增网格运行时的对应源码及 Windows 依赖检查；本草稿不代表这些检查已通过。
> Installer built and exercised; public distribution awaits the mesh runtime's corresponding-source and Windows dependency checks. Draft status is not approval of those checks.

## 简体中文

### 本次变化

- **真正减少 STL 面数和体积**：按区域精简，保留共享接口及不能安全简化的部分。精简比例表示目标移除量，0% 不减面，100% 尽可能精简，不会导出空网格。
- 比例旁显示目标剩余体积；不知道原始大小时只显示百分比，不猜测 MB。导出后显示各 Link 的实际原始/最终大小。
- 可视 STL 和“精简网格”碰撞共用比例；精确网格、原生几何体和复制可视网格保留各自含义。减面不修改质量、质心或惯性。
- 减面在独立进程执行，带超时保护和内容缓存；没有更小的有效结果时保留原网格并提示。
- MuJoCo 目录也使用手动设置的输出名称；许可证可选常用名称，也可直接输入。修复模型信息、输出勾选和不含网格导出的元数据保留。
- 导出进度显示 Link 和序号，结果显示警告及实际网格统计。

### 实测结果

在本次模型上设置移除 70%：

| 可视 STL | 原始 | 最终 | 实际缩小 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 大型 Link | 32.10 MB | 10.64 MB | 66.86% |
| 复杂小型 Link | 6.36 MB | 4.33 MB | 31.91% |
| 全部 Link | 41.35 MB | 16.20 MB | 60.82% |

MB 按十进制计算。比例是目标，不是质量保护条件下的保证值。
四目标全部导出成功，总耗时 8 分 38 秒。ROS1/ROS2 有 10 个可视几何和 10 个碰撞几何，引用及校验和通过；MJCF 两个入口独立加载并执行一步零控制仿真；USD 17 层文件解析、16 个网格非空。

构建时通过 1167 项插件测试、134 项 Core 测试和 9 项官方 MuJoCo 测试。测试不覆盖所有 SW 版本、Isaac Sim 或长时间仿真/训练。大型装配体的惯性校验及首次减面仍可能耗时较长。

### 已知限制与安装

- 四个轮子的碰撞是原生圆柱，不需要碰撞 STL；CSV 仍误保留临时 STL 的存在标记，不影响实际 URDF。部分减面警告重复且仍为英文。
- 某些小细节或复杂区域会保留原状，因此不一定达到目标比例。
- **本条为 Beta 草稿，不替换稳定版 Latest。** 公开发布前须完成文末的第三方检查。
- 安装前备份装配体、关闭全部 SolidWorks，以管理员身份安装 x64 包，再重启 SolidWorks。安装包未做 Authenticode 签名。

[中文手册](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/) · [验证记录](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-10-partition-plugin-integration.md)

## English

### Changes

- Partitioned STL decimation reduces triangles and file sizes while preserving shared interfaces and protected regions. The ratio is requested removal: 0% disables it; 100% requests maximum reduction, never an empty mesh.
- Show target remaining size beside the ratio, percentages only when the source size is unknown, and measured per-Link sizes after export.
- Visual STL and simplified collision meshes share the ratio. Accurate meshes, native primitives and visual-mesh copies keep their meanings. Mass, COM and inertia are unchanged.
- Isolate native reduction with time limits and a content cache; retain the original if no smaller valid result is available.
- Use the configured output name for MuJoCo too; offer editable license presets. Fix metadata/target persistence and metadata handling in mesh-free exports.
- Show per-Link progress, warnings and actual mesh statistics.

### Verification

With 70% requested removal on an example assembly, a large Link decreased from 32.10 MB to 10.64 MB, a complex smaller Link from 6.36 MB to 4.33 MB, and all visual STLs from 41.35 MB to 16.20 MB (60.82% smaller). MB is decimal; source sizes were measured in this export. The target is not a guarantee.

All four targets exported in 8m38s. ROS1/ROS2 references/checksums passed, with 10 visual and 10 collision geometries. Both MJCF entrypoints independently loaded and ran one zero-control step. OpenUSD reopened 17 layers and 16 nonempty meshes.

The build passed 1167 plug-in, 134 Core and 9 official MuJoCo tests. This is not coverage of all SW versions, Isaac Sim, or long simulations/training. Inertia validation and first-time reduction can remain expensive.

### Limitations and installation

- The four wheel collisions are native cylinders, not missing STLs. CSV still retains stale temporary-STL existence flags; delivered URDF is unaffected. Some warnings repeat and remain English.
- Protected details/complex regions may prevent reaching the target ratio.
- **Beta draft only; the stable Latest release is unchanged.** Resolve the third-party prerequisites below before public publication.
- Back up assemblies, close all SolidWorks processes, install the x64 package as administrator, and restart SolidWorks. The installer is not Authenticode-signed.

[English handbook](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/en/) · [verification record](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-10-partition-plugin-integration.md)

## Publication Prerequisites / 公开发布前检查

- Establish complete corresponding-source access for the exact shipped PyMeshLab/native binaries, including necessary submodules and build scripts. A generic upstream homepage is not proof of completeness.
- Verify and provision required native Windows runtime dependencies on a clean supported system. A successful developer-machine test is insufficient.
- See [source/runtime checklist](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/MESH-REDUCTION-SOURCE-NOTICE.txt). Do not remove these checks merely because the release is labelled Beta.
